_context.description: Parser configuration for IGVF CRISPR element-to-gene (E2G) tabular files loaded by CRISPR_element_gene_IGVF_adapter.py.
_context.layout_names: Top-level keys other than `files` and `_context` are layout definitions. Layout names (e.g. t_cell, crudo_tap_seq, pySpade) are shorthand identifiers reflective of each lab's internal naming for the experiment or analysis pipeline. These are not formal IGVF file-format terms.
_context.structure: Each layout describes column semantics and derived metrics for one file shape. The `files` section maps each IGVF file accession to a layout and file-specific options (e.g. targeted_element_types, skip_rows).

columns.p_val: P-value computed with MAST (https://rglab.github.io/MAST/). This method identifies differentially expressed genes between two groups of cells using a hurdle model
columns.avg_log2FC: log fold-change of the average expression between the two groups. Positive values indicate that the gene is more highly expressed in the first group
columns.pct.1: The percentage of cells where the gene is detected in the first group
columns.pct.2: The percentage of cells where the gene is detected in the second group
columns.p_val_adj: The percentage of cells where the gene is detected in the second group
columns.guide_id: gRNA ID of the selected / most significant perturbation per element and target gene
columns.target_gene: ENSEMBL ID of the tested gene
columns.intended_target_name: ENSEMBL ID of the element / TF promoter
columns.intended_target_chr: Chromosome of the element / TF promoter
columns.intended_target_start: Start coordinate of the element / TF promoter
columns.intended_target_end: End coordinate of the element / TF promoter

mechanoenhancer.title: Element-level Seurat/MAST file format specification

columns.p_val: P-value computed with MAST (https://rglab.github.io/MAST/). This method identifies differentially expressed genes between two groups of cells using a hurdle model
columns.avg_log2FC: log fold-change of the average expression between the two groups. Positive values indicate that the gene is more highly expressed in the first group
columns.pct.1: The percentage of cells where the gene is detected in the first group
columns.pct.2: The percentage of cells where the gene is detected in the second group
columns.p_val_adj: Adjusted p-value, based on Bonferroni correction using all genes in the dataset
columns.gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol of the tested gene
columns.ensembl_id: ENSEMBL ID of the tested gene
columns.intended_target_name: Name of target element, i.e. {chr}:{start}-{end}. Same as in guide metadata file

mechanoenhancer.notes: File format specification document reused from `t_cell` layout. Data file format does not actually match the fields defined in file format specification document precisely, i.e. ensembl_id instead of target_gene.

columns.FRACTEL_pval: Element-level p-values for the `intended_target_name` and `readout_gene` pair, as computed by FRACTEL (https://github.com/GersbachlabBioinformatics/FRACTEL)
columns.FRACTEL_pval_fdr_corr: Corrected FRACTEL_pval after applying the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure
columns.FRACTEL_effect_size: Element-level effect-size for the `intended_target_name` and `readout_gene` pair, as computed by FRACTEL (weighted average across guides within an element)
columns.intended_target_name: ID of the targeted element (grouping singleton measurements, like gRNA-gene p-values). In promoter screens, this column will contain the ENSEMBL ID of the targeted gene.
columns.intended_target_start: Start coordinate of the target element
columns.intended_target_end: End coordinate of the target element
columns.readout_gene: ENSEMBL ID of the readout gene

parse_perturb_seq.title: Global_differential_quantification_output file format specification for Parse Perturb-seq

columns.intended_target_name: Name of target element, i.e. {chr}:{start}-{end}. Same as in guide metadata file
columns.guide_id(s): Comma-separated list of guide ids targeting this element (same ids as in guide metadata file)
columns.targeting_chr: Chromosome name of targeted element Gencode/UCSC notation
columns.targeting_start: Start coordinate of the targeted element (0-based)
columns.targeting_end: End coordinate of the targeted element (0-based)
columns.gene_symbol: Gene Symbol according to Ensembl. Useful for downstream analyses
columns.sceptre_log2_fc: Log2 fold change effect size calculated by sceptre
columns.sceptre_adj_p_value: FDR adjusted p-value calculated by sceptre
columns.significant: Specifying whether tested E-G pair is significant
columns.type: Type of the perturbation target, direct or indirect

tap_seq_sceptre_power_XX.title: Per-element output format for TAP-seq

columns.intended_target_name: Name of target element, i.e. {chr}:{start}-{end}. Same as in guide metadata file
columns.guide_id(s): Comma-separated list of guide ids targeting this element (same ids as in guide metadata file)
columns.targeting_chr: Chromosome name of targeted element Gencode/UCSC notation
columns.targeting_start: Start coordinate of the targeted element (0-based)
columns.targeting_end: End coordinate of the targeted element (0-based)
columns.gene_symbol: Gene Symbol according to Ensembl. Useful for downstream analyses
columns.sceptre_log2_fc: Log2 fold change effect size calculated by sceptre
columns.sceptre_adj_p_value: FDR adjusted p-value calculated by sceptre
columns.significant: Specifying whether tested E-G pair is significant
columns.sample_term_name: Cell type / biosample name. Useful when aggregating results from multiple experiments
columns.sample_term_id: UBERON, CL for cell type / biosample
columns.power_at_effect_size_15: (optional) Estimated statistical power to detect a perturbation effect of effect size XX
columns.notes: (optional) Field for optional notes, e.g. reference or source of data
columns.power_at_effect_size_XX: (optional) Estimated statistical power to detect a perturbation effect of effect size XX

tap_seq_sceptre_power_XX.notes: power_at_effect_size_XX is a variable field name that only sometimes actually gets renamed depending on the effect size value ex. power_at_effect_size_15.

crudo_tap_seq.title: File format specification document for CRUDO_noAux analysis output files

columns.name_hg19: Name of target element, i.e. {chr}:{start}-{end}. Hg19 genome coordinates.
columns.name_hg38: Name of target element, i.e. {chr}:{start}-{end}. Hg38 genome coordinates.
columns.n: Number of gRNAs targeting this element
columns.type: Defines the nature of targeted element, ie putative enhancer, TSS, or negative control
columns.EnhancerEffect.noAux.Rep1: Effect of enhancer on target gene expression identified by perturbation effect for replicate 1
columns.EnhancerEffect.noAux.Rep2: Effect of enhancer on target gene expression identified by perturbation effect for replicate 2
columns.EnhancerEffect.noAux: Effect of enhancer on target gene expression identified by perturbation effect averaged across replicates
columns.ci95.EnhancerEffect.noAux.Rep1: 95th confidence interval for enhancer effect for replicate 1
columns.ci95.EnhancerEffect.noAux.Rep2: 95th confidence interval for enhancer effect for replicate 2
columns.ci95.EnhancerEffect.noAux: 95th confidence interval for enhancer effect for replicate averages
columns.pval.EnhancerEffect.noAux: Uncorrected p-value calculated for the replicate averages
columns.adj.pval.EnhancerEffect.noAux.Rep1: FDR adjusted p-value calculated for replicate1
columns.adj.pval.EnhancerEffect.noAux.Rep2: FDR adjusted p-value calculated for replicate2
columns.adj.pval.EnhancerEffect.noAux: FDR adjusted p-value calculated for the replicate averages
columns.Significant: Specifying whether tested E-G pair is significant: TRUE or FALSE

crudo_tap_seq.notes: Differs from the file format specification document: `name` is renamed `name_hg19`.

crudo_flowfish.title: File format specification document for CRUDO_noAux analysis output files

columns.name: Name of target element, i.e. {chr}:{start}-{end}. Hg19 genome coordinates.
columns.name_hg38: Name of target element, i.e. {chr}:{start}-{end}. Hg38 genome coordinates.
columns.n: Number of gRNAs targeting this element
columns.type: Defines the nature of targeted element: putative_enhancer, TSS, or negative_control
columns.EnhancerEffect.noAux.Rep1: Effect of enhancer on target gene expression for replicate 1
columns.EnhancerEffect.noAux.Rep2: Effect of enhancer on target gene expression for replicate 2
columns.EnhancerEffect.noAux: Effect of enhancer on target gene expression averaged across replicates
columns.pval.EnhancerEffect.noAux: Uncorrected p-value for the replicate averages
columns.adj.pval.EnhancerEffect.noAux: FDR adjusted p-value for the replicate averages
columns.Significant: Specifying whether tested E-G pair is significant: TRUE or FALSE

crudo_flowfish.notes: FlowFISH files use type=TSS (not {gene}_TSS) like crudo_tap_seq. TSS rows are promoter self-effects: promoter_of = TargetGeneID.

teloHAEC_flowfish.title: CRISPRi FlowFISH Full Enhancer Score Analysis Submission Format

columns.intended_target_name: Name of the target element, formatted as {chr}:{start}-{end}.
columns.guide_id(s): Comma-separated list of guide IDs targeting this element (must match guide metadata).
columns.targeting_start: Start coordinate of the targeted element
columns.targeting_end: End coordinate of the targeted element
columns.log2_fc: Log2 fold change effect size compared to negative control guides
columns.significant: Indicates whether the tested enhancer-gene pair is significant (TRUE or FALSE)
columns.sample_term_name: Name of the cell type or biosample (useful for multi-experiment aggregation)
columns.sample_term_id: UBERON or CL ID for the biosample or cell type
columns.sample_summary_shor: Short description of the sample, including treatments
columns.notes: (optional) Field for notes, such as reference, source, or annotation details

semantic_columns.notes: Data files have `sample_summary_shor` not `sample_summary_short` as specified in the file format specification document.

scaled_screen.title: File Format Specifications for CRISPRa Scaled Screen Table S4

columns.spacer_g_start: Constant G start of 20bp spacer sequence to promoter Pol III transcription.
columns.n_nonzero_trt: Number of gRNA cells with nonzero expression of putative target gene.
columns.n_nonzero_cntrl: Number of gRNA cells with nonzero expression of putative target gene.
columns.pass_qc: Whether the DE test passed QC.
columns.log_2_fold_change: Log 2 fold change in putative target gene expression between gRNA cells and control cells.
columns.full_piggyflex_oligo: Full sequence of gRNA oligo ordered and cloned into piggyFlex gRNA expression vector.
columns.putative_target_genes: All putative target genes of gRNA.
columns.putative_target_genes_hgnc: All putative target genes of gRNA HGNC symbol format.

scaled_screen.notes: Title derived from portal metadata description property, as no title is provided in the file format specification document.

pySpade.title: pySpade DE table

columns.gene_names: The gene name of differential expressed gene.
columns.gene_name_ensembl: The gene name of differential expressed gene in ENSG format.
columns.chromosome: The chromosome where differential expressed gene is located.
columns.pos: The perturbation region in the screen.
columns.region: The perturbation region in the screen.
columns.intended_target_name: The name of the perturbed element (gene name or genomic region).
columns.intended_target_name_ensmbl: The name of the perturbed element (gene name or genomic region) in ENSG format.
columns.num_cell: The number of cells with perturbation sgRNAs. Note: if the perturbation region has multiple sgRNAs, all the sgRNAs are pooled together.
columns.log(pval)-hypergeom: Natural log p-value of hypergeometric test. This is the initial statistical test without considering background correction method.
columns.fc: The fold change of perturbation cells versus background cells. Bigger than 1 means up-regulation, smaller than 1 means down-regulation. It is calculated as: cpm_perturb / cpm_bg.
columns.Significance_score: Natural log p-value after background correction. Please look at pySpade's paper for more details about the statistical strategy.
columns.fc_by_rand_dist_cpm: The fold change of perturbation cells versus the selected background cells. Bigger than 1 means up-regulation, smaller than 1 means down-regulation.
columns.pval-empirical: The number of background selection whose p-value is smaller than the hypergeometric p-value. Please refer pySpade's paper for more detail.
columns.cpm_perturb: The cpm (counts per million reads) of the gene in cells with perturbation.
columns.cpm_bg: The cpm of the gene in all the other cells.
columns.log2fc: The Log2 of the fc (Fold Change) field.

pySpade.notes: Most fields from the data file are undefined in the file format specification document.

column_catalog_notes.log(pval)-hypergeom: Catalog raw p-value source. Stored natively as hypergeometric_ln_p_value; catalog p_value = exp(column). Initial hypergeometric test (perturbed vs all other cells) with no random-background correction.
column_catalog_notes.Significance_score: Catalog adjusted p-value (q-value) source. Stored natively as gamma_approximation_ln_p_value; catalog p_value_adj = exp(column). Gamma-approximation significance score modeling background and perturbation p-values (per pySpade / Yihan Hon lab).
column_catalog_notes.pval-empirical: Catalog field empirical_p_value. Empirical p-value comparing perturbation hypergeometric p-value to random background draws. Loaded into the database but not returned by the API.
